overall_goal: Measure and add various spices to the pan and a bowl

goals.description: Find and measure turmeric into a bowl
goals.rationale: The person searches the spice cupboard for turmeric, opens it, measures it out, and pours it into a bowl before closing the container.

goals.description: Measure tandoori masala into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person opens the tandoori masala, measures a tablespoon into the bowl, and closes the container.

goals.description: Find and add black mustard seeds to the pan
goals.rationale: The person searches the spice cupboard for black mustard seeds, opens the container, and measures a teaspoon directly into the pan.

goals.description: Find and add cumin seeds to the pan
goals.rationale: The person searches the lower cupboard for cumin seeds, retrieves a spice box, opens the container, and measures two teaspoons into the pan.

goals.description: Add pepper and salt to the pan
goals.rationale: The person moves oil to access the pepper, measures a quarter teaspoon of pepper into the pan, and then measures and adds half a teaspoon of salt.

goals.description: Measure garam masala into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person retrieves garam masala from the spice box, selects a tablespoon measure, and adds two tablespoons to the bowl of spices.
